links.comparator_used: Same LLMs without RAG (training knowledge alone)
links.outcome: Overall accuracy on 600 nuclear medicine technology board-style questions across 15 topics
links.effect: With RAG, overall accuracy was 0.787 (openai_nvidia_gpt-4o_final), 0.783 (openai_mxbai_gpt-4o_final), 0.773 (Anthropic Opus) and 0.750 (Google Gemini 1.5 Pro); the Llama3 ollama_llama3 model without RAG had the lowest accuracy. The abstract gives no matched without-RAG scores.
links.quote: This study also demonstrates that adding a RAG workflow can increase the accuracy of an off-the-shelf model.
